auditTitle: FOUNDER SAFETY LOCK SECURITY PATCH & FULL AUDIT REPORT

hardcoded_credentials_found.remediation: REMOVED. Replaced with JWT session validation, Founder role authorization, and bcrypt password hash verification against database user records.
REMOVED. Replaced with active user role check and server-enforced JWT/bcrypt verification.
REMOVED. Replaced with crypto.randomBytes(16).toString('hex') dynamic secret generation.

vulnerabilities_found.details: Hardcoded password array allowed potential unauthorized deletion if static strings were guessed or discovered in client code.

vulnerabilities_found.vulnerability: Static Password Strings in Purge Method
vulnerabilities_found.details: Client repository methods referenced static fallback passwords.

remediation_actions: Completely purged hardcoded password strings ('admin123', 'founder2026', '123456') from all client and server files.
Upgraded /api/admin/founder-permanent-purge endpoint to mandate Bearer JWT session token.
Enforced Founder role validation (role === 'FND' || 'FOUNDER') via JWT decoded session payload.
Implemented bcryptjs password hash comparison against the Founder user record stored in PostgreSQL / usersDb.json.
Updated client RestoreDeletedDataCenter component to pass Authorization header with active JWT access token.
Generated dynamic crypto random tokens for debug/trace routes instead of static fallback strings.
